notes.title: An Update on the Status of Eden Falling's Graphical Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hey there, survivors!

As you might remember, at the beginning of this year we announced that Eden Falling would be undergoing a significant graphical overhaul as we process the game through the High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP) tool.

Since it’s been ongoing for a couple months now, we just wanted to reassure you that things are progressing smoothly and to ask for your patience for a little while longer! As a reminder of where Eden Falling’s visuals stand right now, here are some snapshots of how the environments look currently, pre-HDRP conversion:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/af1cb992fe997dcddf23e3706768607a2956cbc3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/f048483e9eaedaa2b0c96cbe41df905e69d91fc6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/ed9a9d356c4a27b1a594b0509c217cd3c8822fe9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/c89e760b2ccced62eafa5eeb8860a03fdc0cfad1.png[/img]

Not too shabby, right? Nevertheless, there’s always room for improvement, and just wait til you see what things will look like once we can show off the finished HDRP conversion results! 😉

Putting everything through the Pipeline is a time-consuming activity (all good things require patience), but it likely won’t take too much longer and we can’t wait to give you an in-depth look at the transformation when it’s ready!

In the meantime, if you’d like to hop into the Alpha to help us polish Eden Falling into the best game it can be, you can email us at [url=marketing@razoredgegames.com]marketing@razoredgegames.com[/url] until March 15th and we’ll get you set up with a Steam key for the Alpha!

If you do enter the Alpha, be sure to send us all your constructive feedback here:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1CXtYD77eQc7w2_K5C6zBK_8RSaa0Ei3U9MJCl-8-NM8/edit]Eden Falling Alpha 2 Bug Report Form[/url]

To stay in the loop about future updates and improvements coming to the game, please wishlist Eden Falling on Steam, join our [url=https://edenfalling.razoredgegames.com/]mailing list[/url], and give us a follow on our various socials:


[url=https://edenfalling.razoredgegames.com/]Website[/url]

notes.title: A Rundown on Current Bug Fixes in the Works
notes.notes:
Hey there, survivors!

We’ve been getting a lot done in the first few weeks of 2022, so we wanted to check in to let you know about some of the bug fixes and general improvements that we’ve been working on lately!

Here’s a quick rundown on some of the things that we’re focusing on addressing at the moment:
[list]
[*] Flat lighting on assets in certain environments
[*] NPC clipping issues
[*] Missing hair and clothing materials on some NPCs
[*] Contract drone spawning in the wrong orientation
[*] Geometry distortions in the environment after combat encounters
[*] Fixing strobing lights in the bar that could be a seizure risk
[*] Bug that prevents cards from being drawn during combat
[*] Incorrect sizing on certain objects
[*] Loading screens dropping resolution when the game is minimized
[*] Misaligned shadows in some areas
[*] Ration prompt appearing at inappropriate times
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/c80d0f8797134b56b8263d9f82f7ccc294a16e34.png[/img]
[i]The old man scene is just one of many areas where we've been implementing several bug fixes[/i]

As you can see, we’re starting the year strong and we have no plans of slowing down! We have a lot more exciting updates to share throughout the year and we look forward to sharing more about that with all of you soon!

In the meantime, if you’d like to hop into the Alpha to help us polish Eden Falling into the best game it can be, you can email us at [url=marketing@razoredgegames.com]marketing@razoredgegames.com[/url] and we’ll get you set up with a Steam key for the Alpha!

notes.title: New Patch Updates for Eden Falling Alpha
notes.notes:
Happy Tuesday, survivors!

We’ve been busy implementing a lot of fresh features and bug fixes into the Eden Falling Alpha lately, so we wanted to give you a quick rundown on what’s new in case you missed it! 

Across the last few patches, we’ve had all sorts of snazzy new updates, including:
[list]
[*] Lens bootup SFX added to intro cutscene
[*] Targeting Reticule SFX was fixed to play properly
[*] Bar Music - no longer plays during character creator
[*] Removed enemy runaway camera for better visibility in the tutorial
[*] Glitching object materials resolved in Bar
[*] Updated Settlement scene
[*] Fixed wolf spider death ragdoll timing
[*] Moved a few NPCs around in the main menu scene
[*] Gender selection dissipation effect now added in to transition away from the selection and into the cinematic
[*] Tutorial contract drone not clipping through buildings anymore, just comes straight down and straight back up
[/list]

So if you haven’t had a chance to hop into the Alpha in a while, now’s the perfect time to jump back in and see what’s changed! Plus there are a lot more exciting things to be added in the near future as well of course 😉.

If you’re a new player and wondering how you can get your hands on a Steam key to try out the Alpha, you’re in luck! We currently have a key giveaway running in conjunction with our friends over at iGames.gg, and you can sign up to receive a FREE key at [url=https://game.intel.com/us/giveaways/eden-falling-closed-alpha-key-giveaway]Intel Gaming Access[/url]! Just fill out the form pictured below and you’ll be exploring the Afterfall in no time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/b801ef3ad37b7637c2bc7756f49e84b9233bcdcc.png[/img]

Be sure to act quickly, since there’s a limited supply and keys are awarded on a first come, first serve basis!

With new updates, there may be some pesky new bugs on loose, so as always, please use this form to notify us of any bugs you come across:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1CXtYD77eQc7w2_K5C6zBK_8RSaa0Ei3U9MJCl-8-NM8/edit]Eden Falling Alpha 2 Bug Report Form

notes.title: Found a bug? Report it here! + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
With the launch of the Eden Falling pre-alpha demo, we want to make sure that your feedback is seen by our devs. If you've found any bugs while playing the demo, fill out this Google Form to report it and our team will send the issues to the right folks so they can begin building a better experience for our players!

[url=https://forms.gle/C88EYALDhPwcFLCJ7]Report Bugs Here!
[/url]
Do your best to describe the bug in detail, including what actions you took leading to the discovery of the bug. Make sure to check out the changelog and instructions below to make sure your game is up-to-date.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/727660/discussions/0/3081006600721101539/]List of known issues here.[/url]

Thank you for playing the Eden Falling pre-alpha demo. We look forward to hearing from you!



[h1][b]Eden Falling HotFix 00.54.28:[/b][/h1]

Hey Everyone! An update patch was pushed through, and more fixes will come over the next few days!

[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b][list][*]Animations for Characters in the startup sequence have been updated.
[*]Added additional sound effects in settlements for drones
[*]Updated Merchant steal to function better.
[*]Player sheet camera updated.
[*]Fixed infinite loop issue in Faction Quiz
[*]Set the selector rings in the Character creator UI to turn off when switching back and forth between radials.
[*]Added looting sound[/list][h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*]UI doesn’t appropriately scale for many monitors when at full screen.  We’ve temporarily forced the game into windowed mode at 16x9 resolutions until we can get the UI scaling appropriately.
[*]Some users are experiencing white “mannequin” NPCs, while others have their NPCs load perfectly as soon as they enter a scene.
[*]Sometimes, the Use button in the tutorial will fail to execute.
[*]Rarely, the checkmark for the first tutorial box fails to progress the tutorial.
[*]Initiative Icons either don’t appear or “fly away” during the player’s first encounter and do not return.
[*]The highlighted numbers on the action cards (the most likely values) have started to disappear.
[/list]
Thank you for your patience and understanding!

[h1][b]Eden Falling HotFix 00.53.53:[/b][/h1]

Hey Everyone! An update patch was pushed through, and more fixes will come over the next few days!

[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b] [h3]There were many Character Creator issues[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted volume in the bar so the NPC dialogue can be heard
[*]Adjusted volume for character creator music
[*]Adjusted volume for button sounds
[*]Fixed a T-poser character.
[*]Swapped out some sitting animations in the comms center.
[*]Updated some Text elements in Inventory and Merchant UI’s
[*]Graphical settings now function.
[*]Fixed an issue with the search and encounter phases’ ending up crashing
[*]Fixed a bug with random faction assignment
[*]Fixed some minor Character Creator UI elements.
[/list][h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] When making a new character and going through the tutorial section we have cut out the merchant section and at the end, you are sent back to the Main Menu. Once there you can select the character you made or make a new character without the tutorial.
[*] Also, We are aware of hair issues, eye issues on the old man and kid, and the extended time between leaving the bar and receiving the first tip. We will be addressing those shortly.
[/list]
[h3]Those that have already downloaded the Pre-Alpha Demo and have issues will have to update their registries and delete saved characters. We are sorry for the inconvenience.[/h3]

[b]To clear your player preferences follow these directions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Open your registry editor and delete the keys at
HKEYCurrentUser/Software/RazorEdgeGames/Eden Falling
[/list][b]If you want your new install to behave like a fresh install[/b]
[list][*] Delete the Eden Falling folder entirely.
[/list]
[b][h3]Below are directions only if you would like to play the tutorial again.[/h3][/b]
[b]To play the tutorial again[/b]
[list]
[*] Just delete SkipTutorial[/list]or[list]
[*] If you look in there and SkipTutorial's value is 1 and you want to skip the tutorial, you can leave it as it is.
[/list]
[h3]Additionally[/h3]
If you have a character, you'll need to clear out existing characters.
[list]
[*] Open the game folder in your steam directory, go to Eden_falling_data, StreamingAssets, Saved, then delete all the CharSlot folders.
[/list]
[b][h2]If you do not follow these steps the game will not run correctly.[/h2][/b]
Thank you for your patience and understanding!

[b]Warning
The registry is very important. Please only delete what we have instructed here and follow the directions exactly. [/b]

[h2]Small Update and Patch![/h2]

We are so excited for all the interest and feedback. We appreciate that everyone understands this is a Pre-Release Alpha build and so some things are missing and or not working as well as we hoped.

We are aware that the current build has issues in the character creator, and we got our best guys working on it as we speak! We should have it updated a bit later today.

Once again thank you for your patience and well wishes!
